stops.method: GitHub issue search, default scope title+body+comments (mcp__github__search_pull_requests, total_count); PRs counted once however often the text appears
blockers: No rate-limit refusal: about 63 search calls in about 10 minutes.

Only text posted to GitHub is searchable. Refusals from local runs (commit-check --local, the pre-push hook, gate stages whose message stays in .gate/records logs) never reach a PR, so 0 means never posted, not never fired.
Hits include PRs that introduced or described a rule, or quoted local test output (verified: #770 quotes its own effort refusal), so non-zero counts are upper bounds on stops.
One fragment per function and current wording only: multi-message functions and reworded older messages are undercounted.
STATUS comments are edited in place, so past status words (BLOCKED, held) are overwritten and invisible to search.

Six functions have no usable literal (null); defects.chain_errors and audit_chain.chain_errors share one literal; three fragments are under 4 words (missing Neon branch, units.companions, registry pins pnpm).
Search ignores punctuation, so phrases match as token sequences.

legend.stops_or_spends.class: stops | spends | configures (parameters, by reader and unit; heuristic, phase 1 confirms) | governs (decisions) | assumes (premises) | stops (refusals) | spends (routines and resources)
legend.owner.named: true when an x-source, a decision row, a docstring or a premise source names who asked
legend.review_date: null everywhere: nothing in the registry, the decision register or the premise register carries a review date (that is the finding of this census)
legend.fired.count: real firings when readable; null when the evidence is not readable here (.gate/records lives on the box); premises: plans and PRs recorded as dependents
legend.fired.git_log: commits whose message names the row (word match for D- and P- ids); the clone history starts 2026-10-26, so it is a lower bound
legend.fired.retros: docs/units/*/retro.md files that name the row
legend.fired.basis: proxy = mentions only, not firings; dependents = the premise record
legend.domain: what the row governs; groups.json cuts the census along these domains
legend.estimate_min: audit minutes for the row in the estimate model
legend.can_stop: Q0: true when the row can stop the flow, false when it cannot, null when the group audit answers it
legend.stops_flow: how often it stopped the flow, read from PR history (PRs whose text or comments carry its refusal message); a row that can stop and was never measured carries a finding
legend.question: the standing question every row must answer at any time (Daniel 17:09 BRT 28/10)
